title: A股热筹监控
note: 午前同时点成交约 1.18 万亿元，较昨日同时点放量约三成，宽度偏弱；半导体与元件走强，光模块冲高回落，影视走弱。谨慎跟：先观察东山精密与剑桥科技，不追中际旭创，不跟影视。
noteEn: By late morning, same-time turnover was about RMB 1.18 trillion, roughly 30% higher than yesterday at the same time, with weak breadth. Semiconductors and components were strong; optical modules spiked and then fell back; film and television weakened. Follow with care: watch 东山精密 and 剑桥科技 first, do not chase 中际旭创, and do not follow film and television.

title: A股热筹监控
note: 11-12 两市放量下跌、宽度塌陷，隔夜英伟达已官方确认黄仁勋辞职；今日跟筹建议为暂不跟，先看中际旭创对隔夜冲击的定价。
noteEn: On 12 Nov both exchanges saw higher turnover but lower prices, with breadth collapsing. Overnight, NVIDIA officially confirmed Jensen Huang's resignation. Today's follow-the-money advice is not to follow; first watch 中际旭创's pricing of the overnight shock.
